description: This file defines internal classes and enums related to transaction records within the Orleans.Transactions namespace. It includes the 'CommitRole' enum, which specifies the role of a participant in a transaction, and the 'TransactionRecord<TState>' class, which encapsulates the state and metadata of a transaction at each participant, providing properties and methods to manage transaction lifecycle aspects.

classes.name: TransactionRecord
classes.description: Represents a record of a transaction at a participant, managing state, role, and synchronization primitives necessary for distributed transaction coordination.

methods.name: AddRead
methods.description: Increments the count of read operations performed in this transaction.

methods.name: AddWrite
methods.description: Increments the count of write operations performed in this transaction.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the transaction record for debugging purposes.
